top_findings.title: No head-to-head tool between two named teams
top_findings.evidence: server.go:25-32 defines 5 tools; none accepts two team names. search_matches (server.go:27, soccer.go:144) and team_stats (server.go:28, soccer.go:234) each take a single `team`, so head-to-head W/L/D between two clubs cannot be requested. R11 how_to_verify unmet. First evaluator's R11 claim CONFIRMED.
top_findings.suggestion: Add a head_to_head tool taking team_a and team_b that filters matches to those two clubs and reports each side's W/L/D + goals.

top_findings.title: Brasileirão loaded twice without dedup — team_stats & competition_stats double-count 2019
top_findings.evidence: soccer.go:34-41 loads Brasileirao_Matches.csv as 'Brasileirão' and soccer.go:45 loadHistorical loads novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv also as 'Brasileirão'; each independently holds 380 season-2019 rows (38 Flamengo matches each, verified in data). Stats() (soccer.go:234-268) and Average() (soccer.go:288-301) match by normalized substring, so team_stats('Flamengo',2019)->76 played (W56) and competition_stats(2019)->760 matches. First evaluator's dup-load claim CONFIRMED. Captured on the separate factual_accuracy axis (0.5), not as a missing capability.
top_findings.suggestion: Deduplicate matches on (season, date±1d, home, away) after normalizing team names, or scope Brasileirão aggregation to one canonical source file.
